about_the_game:
The Haunted Nora Apartment is a 2D Top-Down Survival Horror game based on the story of the Nora Apartment which was built during the early 2000s.

Nora Apartment, built during the early 2000s, is one of the most haunted locations in the NU city. Some tragic incidents that occurred during the late 2000s resulted in the onset of the paranormal activities. It was reported that a murder took place in one of the rooms of the apartment. A woman was murdered by a wanted criminal using a knife, who was later arrested by the NU police after verifying the CCTV footage collected from the apartment maintenance office. The murder convict died under mysterious circumstances in the prison of NU in 2009. It was reported that the spirit of the murderer was often seen in the different parts of the Nora Apartment building. Around the same time, one of the family members living there died in an elevator accident, and his spirit is often seen on the ground floor area of the building even to this day.

The basement area of the building is said to be very active, and the evil creatures are often seen lurking in the shadows. It is believed that the tragic incidents that occurred inside the apartment in the past opened a portal to the spirit world, which increased the paranormal activity inside the building.

You play as Pavlo, a paranormal enthusiast, and your mission is to investigate the entire apartment building in order to experience the paranormal. Will you be able to escape the building safely?

Key Features:

  • Explore the entire Nora apartment building.
  • Come face to face with the Evil spirits!
  • Collect items like necklace, keys, Satan book etc.
  • Avoid deadly traps like fire, knives, spikes etc.
  • Explore the spirit world!
  • About half an hour of paranormal investigation.

Warning:

This game contains flashing lights which may not be suitable for people with epilepsy or other photosensitive conditions. Player discretion is advised.
